topic: The Engine of AI: Cost Functions and Gradient Descent

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Prediction Gap
lecture_lines: Neural networks are like students guessing answers.
We compare the prediction to ground truth.
The loss is the distance between them.
animations: Display 'Prediction' and 'Actual' values side by side represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/student.svg].
Highlight the gap between prediction and actual as 'Error'.
Show error as a vertical line segment between two points.
Emphasize the error segment using a vibrant #FF00FF color.

sections.title: The Cost Function: The Landscape of Errors
lecture_lines: Cost functions map error across weight landscapes.
Think of it as a mountain range.
Goal: reach the valley of minimum error.
animations: Draw a 2D curve representing a cost function landscape, visually resembling a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mountain.svg].
Mark a point on the curve as 'Current Model State'.
Use #FFFF00 color to highlight the 'Current Model State'.

sections.title: Gradient Descent: The Downhill Step
lecture_lines: Gradient descent helps us find the valley.
The gradient shows the steepest downward slope.
Learning rates determine our step size.
animations: Show [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ball.svg] rolling down the side of the curve.
Label the slope of the curve as 'Gradient'.
Use #00FFFF color to represent the gradient vector clearly.

sections.title: The Iterative Loop: Training
lecture_lines: Training is a continuous four-step cycle.
We guess, calculate cost, find gradients, update.
Weights adjust until the target is hit.
animations: Show a cycle: Calculate Error -> Adjust Parameters -> Repeat using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/target.svg] to represent the goal.
Highlight the parameter update step in #00FF00.
Animate the model state moving closer to the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/target.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion and Intuition Check
lecture_lines: Gradient descent minimizes error through optimization.
High learning rates jump over valleys.
animations: Display a summary text: 'Training = Reducing Total Error'.
Animate the cost function curve flattening near the minimum.
Final highlight of the minimum point with #FF4500.
